question: Who among the following won the FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Spain**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup** is a biennial international women's football tournament for players under the age of 17 organized by the Fundefineddundefinedration Internationale de Football Association (FIFA).
 
• New Zealand has never won the FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup. They have participated in the tournament six times but have never made it past the quarter-finals.
 
• Colombia has also never won the FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup. They have participated in the tournament five times and their best performance was reaching the quarter-finals in 2014 and 2016.
 
• Japan has won the FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup twice, in 2014 and 2018. They were the defending champions but lost to Spain in the quarter-finals in the 2022 edition of the tournament.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Spain** is a nation that lies in southwest Europe and has portions of its land in Africa, the Mediterranean Sea, and the Atlantic Ocean.
 
• It is the fourth most populous member state of the European Union and the largest nation in Southern Europe.
 
• Its territory included most of the Iberian Peninsula, as well as the Canary Islands in the Atlantic, the Balearic Islands in the Mediterranean, and the African autonomous cities of Melilla and Ceuta.
 
• Peninsular Spain is bounded to the north by the Bay of Biscay, France, and Andorra; to the east and south by Gibraltar and the Mediterranean Sea; and to the west by Portugal and the Atlantic Ocean. Madrid is the capital and biggest city of Spain.
